summary.doc_sync_escalation_note: CLAUDE.md Section 2.1 names 'Layer 2', 'Layer-2', and 'README_LAYER2.md' explicitly. Any approved rename must propagate to CLAUDE.md under Section 11 update obligations, but CLAUDE.md amendment is itself a governance-class action requiring workflow-enforced approval (CLAUDE.md Section 15). This is a Tier 1 (constitutional) vs Tier 3 (documentation-wide refactor) conflict requiring explicit resolution before execution.
summary.notes: Two claims are compliant (C-05, C-07, C-10): the canonical status of README_LAYER2.md, CLAUDE.md's governance scope, and fail-closed application are all well-supported. Four claims are review-only (C-01, C-02, C-08, C-09, C-11, C-12): these are non-strong or partially-sourced claims that do not independently block. Three claims are blocking (C-03, C-04, C-06): the core rename assertions lack role-matched canonical proof and carry unresolved conflict with the constitutional document. Recommended path: obtain explicit architecture-doc confirmation that 'truth_store' and 'decision_layer' are the intended canonical names, resolve the 'Decision Engine' collision risk, and establish a CLAUDE.md amendment governance path before any execution proceeds.
